{{Top|leg}}
The '''Devist family''' consisted of the five members of the [[Jenth-44]] sleeper cell of [[Soontir Fel/Legends|Soontir Fel]] [[Cloning/Legends|clones]] set up by [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Mitth'raw'nuruodo]]. Residing on [[Pakrik Minor]], the five men took on identities as the "Devist brothers", each using various hairstyles and facial hair to keep from looking too similar. [[Carib Devist|Carib]], [[Dobrow Devist|Dobrow]], [[Hovarb Devist|Hovarb]], [[Sabmin Devist|Sabmin]], and [[Tabric Devist]] began careers as farmers, marrying local women and having children by them and building an identity as a tight-knit farming family. Not even their spouses knew that the "brothers" were in fact clones.
